subject.title: [Feature]: Telegram Business Bot support (business_message / business_connection updates)

question: Should bundled Telegram support accept Telegram Business personal-DM handling now, and what per-account `business_connection_id` persistence and outbound authority model should be required?
rationale: The feature fits major-channel support, but it changes personal-DM access and outbound Business-account authority after a same-repo implementation was already closed for routing and security blockers.

options.title: Approve bounded Business support
options.body: Implement it in the bundled Telegram plugin with per-account durable state, disconnect cleanup, Business-aware keys, docs, tests, and live Telegram proof.

options.title: Require owner design first
options.body: Keep this tracker open but require a short maintainer design note for access control, persistence, and outbound authority before accepting another PR.

options.title: Defer bundled support
options.body: Keep external relay or proxy approaches as the supported workaround until maintainers explicitly approve a bundled Telegram Business model.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded Business support
recommendation.body: Implement it in the bundled Telegram plugin with per-account durable state, disconnect cleanup, Business-aware keys, docs, tests, and live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest current routing signal from blame on the affected Telegram files and from closing the prior same-repo implementation for owner-direction review.
